title: idem-runtime scenario state
description: Domain state of the idem-runtime behavior backend. One live job per create; the idempotency cache that prevents duplicates lives in the sealed store, not here, so this document names what the domain holds after the gateway already honored replay.

jobs.description: Live jobs keyed by job identifier.

order.description: Identifiers of live jobs in insertion order.

jobId.description: Job identifier allocated by the ids service.

text.description: Job text, echoed from the create request.

status.description: Lifecycle status. The synthetic backend never advances it.

created_at.description: Creation time from the deterministic clock.
